name: 2MASX J13481399-3322547 (Hubble)
blurb: 2MASX J13481399-3322547, the brightest galaxy of a galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: 2masxj134813993322547-hubble
story: This giant galaxy is one of the brightest cluster galaxies Hubble imaged to measure how fast galaxies fall toward the Shapley Supercluster. Astronomers have since used the same images to count the globular clusters swarming around it.

claims.text: J13481399-3322547 is in the sample of HST program 10429 brightest cluster galaxies
Program 10429 images were taken to measure infall velocities within the Shapley Supercluster
The sample galaxies are giant, massive early-type galaxies
Its globular cluster system was studied in these Hubble images
